mainImage.alt: Exterior of the Park Slope Food Coop in Brooklyn, New York
mainImage.caption: The Park Slope Food Coop in Brooklyn. Founded in 1973, it has a long history of socially conscious boycotts, including against apartheid South Africa and Pinochet's Chile.
